name: Potash fertilizer mix; average production, at US regional storehouse
description:
This process represents an average mixture of potash fertilizers used in the US.
Additional information from product flow: mass K in 1 kg mixture
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3253: Pesticide, Fertilizer, and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing

processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Includes transport of the fertilizers to the regional storehouse.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: US average mix based on ERS data
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Representative unit processes were selected from USEI for each of the types of fertilizer reported by the ERS.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project in 2010

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.

dataSetOwner.name: University of Arkansas Office for Sustainability
